# Tolland Freight carries every wholesale delivery through 2027

## Decision Question

Who carries Pellworth's wholesale orders once the current contract ends in June?

## Decision Outcome

Tolland Freight carries every wholesale delivery through the end of 2027, on a renewed contract signed at the May carrier review.

## Alternatives Considered

- Running two vans in-house, ruled out on driver cover.
- A month-to-month rate with Tolland, ruled out because it lost the multi-year discount.

## Approved By

Hal Brennan, at the 2026-05-14 carrier review.
